title: 1Password Variables
description: 1Password group: non-secret vault/item coordinates resolved on the controller at run time. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'onePassword'.

onePasswordVault.description: 1Password vault name. Role default, overridden by the downstream inventory or -e; resolved on the controller.

onePasswordTailscaleAPIKey.description: 1Password Tailscale auth-key item name. Role default, overridden by the downstream inventory or -e; resolved on the controller.
